entities.name: Alban de Villeneuve-Bargemon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: The Viscount Alban de Villeneuve-Bargemont was a French economist and politician. A Catholic nobleman, he was among the first, alongside Armand de Melun, to denounce industrial exploitation and to introduce early social legislation.
